_help: Copy of this file is created as publish/local/config.json by `python publish/publish.py setup`. Fill in YOUR values there; that file is git-ignored and never published.
private_strings: words or paths that must never appear in anything public: your Windows user name, your real e-mail or its domain, your folder names
signing_key_paths: full path of your release private key file (its contents are searched for and blocked; the file is never read for any other purpose)
dev_tree: full path of your development folder (only tools/sync_from_dev.py uses it)
dev_literals: a path as it appears in your dev scripts
the neutral placeholder it is replaced with, e.g. X:\__CAPITAL_WORKDIR__
